Task 1: ChatGPT¶

ChatGPT Prompt¶

Write a poem about Peloponnesian War

ChatGPT Answer¶

Shadows on Hellenic Shores

Steel glints in the sun on Peloponnesian sands,
While Athens’s ports hum with ships made of pine,
From Attic sky to Laconian lands,
Storm clouds gather along the battle line.

A city famed for words and art,
Another for discipline’s fierce vow—
Philosophy meets the sharpened dart,
As dawn of war engulfs them now.

Ships in the harbor, rumors in the wind,
Rowers’ oars strike the wine-dark sea;
Long Walls stand, yet plague creeps in,
No fortress can quell dread’s silent plea.

Fields ablaze where Spartans tread,
Their brassy helms shining in the smoke;
Farmers pray for peace, dread overhead,
Ambition and pride remain unbroke.

At last, the distant horns of defeat
Toll softly over Athens’s fall,
Marble columns cradle weary feet,
Surrender etched on each battered wall.

Yet from scorched earth, seeds still find room—
The spirit of freedom endures the night;
In dialogues and songs, it banishes gloom,
Kindling new dawn with tomorrow’s light.
